text: The world is the believer's prison and the disbeliever's paradise.
The most beloved of people to Allah are those who are most beneficial to the people.
The merciful are shown mercy by the Most Merciful.
He who believes in Allah and the Last Day should not harm his neighbor.
Give glad tidings to the believers.
A strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than a weak one.
Nothing befalls you except that which Allah has decreed for you.
Walk uprightly and speak the truth.
Show mercy to each other and you will be shown mercy.
The best among you are those who have the best manners and character.
Feed the hungry, visit the sick, and free the captive.
Smiling in the face of your brother is charity.
